## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`fix(job): …`); it becomes the commit message on `main`.
- [ ] A behaviour change comes with a spec revision or ADR (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] `make check` passes, and `make web-check` if `web/` changed.
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, `.torrent` or `.nzb` files are committed.
